# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Madden Property Consultants are delighted to present this bright and well-presented two-bedroom apartment in the highly sought-after Castleforbes Square development, in the north Docklands. Situated on the fourth floor, this attractive apartment enjoys a west-facing aspect and benefits from a large balcony, providing an excellent outdoor space and plenty of natural light throughout the afternoon…
